entries.title: 2 Chronicles 4:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Their form - The old form which God prescribed to Moses.

entries.title: 2 Chronicles 4:8
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Ten tables - Whereon the shew - bread was set, ver. 19. Perhaps each of these had twelve loaves on it. As the house was enlarged, so was the provision.

entries.title: 2 Chronicles 4:16
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: His father - He is so called because Solomon usually called him by that name out of that great respect which he bare to him for his excellent art and service which he did for him: it being usual to call great artists and inventors of things by this name.

entries.title: 2 Chronicles 4:20
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The manner - According to the prescription of God to Moses.

entries.title: 2 Chronicles 4:22
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Of gold - In part; they were made of wood, but covered with golden plates.
